summary: Completed backend+frontend verification for legacy withdrawal period edit on public preview URL, including required regressions and production build. Backend scenarios passed; frontend exposed an RBAC route-gap and unstable commit polling visibility.

ui_bugs.issue: Admin Support can directly open /admin/withdraw (status filter and withdrawal list render), even though sidebar hides the Withdraw menu and requested edit access scope is Finance/Super only.

integration_issues.issue: Preview renders correctly (cutoff and balance delta visible), but UI completion state was not observed within automation wait window in one run (state stayed pending); requires manual confirmation of polling/result rendering reliability.

action_items: Add page-level role guard for /admin/withdraw so admin_support cannot access the route directly (not only hidden nav).
Stabilize legacy edit modal completion feedback/polling so submit consistently transitions to complete/error state in UI automation.
After fixes, rerun desktop+mobile UI flow for finance/support and confirm commit completion messaging appears deterministically.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend legacy edit APIs are strongly guarded: preview/commit are limited to super_admin/admin_finance and reject web withdrawals; month format validation is enforced via Pydantic YYYY-MM pattern.
Preview and commit responses in tested flows did not expose Mongo _id/ObjectId fields.
GET /api/withdraw/admin correctly sets legacy_editable=true only for paid legacy rows with period_to; web/direct rows stayed false in regression tests.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (core load, visibility, preview, responsive checks passed; route-RBAC and commit-state reliability issue found)

seed_data_creation: No persistent production seed changes. Backend tests used isolated random fixtures with cleanup. Verified phase62 baseline period remains 2026-03 after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use finance/support credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. phase62 legacy row exists and currently shows period 2026-03 baseline. Support direct URL access to /admin/withdraw is reproducible.
rca of the issue: RCA (frontend RBAC): AdminLayout hides Withdraw nav for support, but App route /admin/withdraw is wrapped only by broad ADMIN_ROLES protected route. Because AdminWithdraw component itself has no role guard, support can access page directly by URL. Mitigation: enforce role gate (super_admin/admin_finance) at route level or inside page component.
